value.title: ROUTES timing: aggregate bound versus whole writes

sections.name: body
sections.value:
ROUTES timing has no isolated live timer. With pm-001's approval, use native `pij-rs --json directory routes --project pij-fleet` as a conservative aggregate bound: the real handler runs regenerate twice plus one standalone build, store reads and formatting. Time from native CLI launch to completion; do not substitute a reimplementation or call the result an isolated rebuild duration.

On 08 Nov, merged #168 at c7d660c, this bound was 31.73 ms with 9 role documents, 8 active, 11 unique scopes (3 paths, 8 rules), zero overlaps and unchanged role inputs. That closes P168-N001 only as not material at this scale under the approved 100 ms criterion. Quadratic scope/overlap work remains; no growth trend or large/dense-directory bound was measured.

Whole output/memory-write times also include seven normal Git calls and ddocs validation/build. They are whole-write bounds, not ROUTES timings. Keep raw receipts, current role/scope counts and the measurement boundary together.
